characterQuestions.question: You've assembled your team for your quest. Every team needs different player types. Which one are you?

options.text: The one checking the guides before the mission starts
The one wandering off to explore
The one upgrading everything
The one that makes sure no one gets left behind

characterQuestions.question: At the start of your adventure, you've inherited a neglected piece of land. What excites you most?

options.text: Unlock every secret, challenge and hidden reward
Explore caves, forests, and places off the beaten path
Transform it into something beautiful and thriving
Get to know the local community and build strong connections

characterQuestions.question: Nice! You've found a cheatcode for unlimited money. Be honest... what disappears first?

options.text: The inventory. I'm collecting everything
The map fog. I'm exploring everything
The starter house. I'm building a mansion
The original storyline. It's about to become very dramatic

characterQuestions.question: On your travels you find a legendary artefact that nobody has seen for centuries! Your first thought is...

options.text: I need to know how this works!
I wonder what other secrets I can find!
Imagine what I can make with this!
Who else can benefit from this discovery?

characterQuestions.question: Almost there! You reach the guarded gates of the Myth Monster's lair. Your path is blocked by ancient guardians. What do you do?

options.text: Study the guardians' attack patterns and uncover their weaknesses
Search the surronding ruins for a way around
Craft a tool that can break through the defenses
Rally your team and coordinate a plan to get everyone through
